proposal.summary: Cross-site scripting (XSS) in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3: an administrative user can configure specially crafted settings that cause an arbitrary script to execute in the web browser of another administrative user.
proposal.affected_product: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3
proposal.cwe_quote: an arbitrary script may be executed on the web browser of the other user who is accessing the affected product with an administrative privilege.

PR.quote: If a user who can access the affected product with an administrative privilege configures specially crafted settings, an arbitrary script may be executed on the web browser of the other user who is accessing the affected product with an administrative privilege.

S.quote: an arbitrary script may be executed on the web browser of the other user who is accessing the affected product with an administrative privilege.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce the issue on CONPROSYS CHS < 3.5.3 by configuring crafted settings as an administrative user to confirm persistent XSS. If confirmed, request vendor fix (input validation/encoding for the affected settings) and recommend temporary mitigations: restrict administrative access, apply network-level protections, and disable untrusted admin input where possible.
